notes: This contract covers the bounded timestamped regional Update Attribute Values path in the embedded development profile. A committed update-region association feeds a timestamped attribute passel; only active overlapping regional attribute triples are eligible, while passive triples remain retained without arranging reflection; the timestamped cases do not independently test that mode selector. Time-constrained recipients receive the reflection before the matching Time Advance Grant while non-time-constrained recipients receive the accepted timestamped callback immediately. The federation-owned recipient ledger lets Retract suppress the pending constrained delivery and invoke Request Retraction for the delivered nonconstrained recipient; the recipient's Convey Region Designator Sets switch gates optional sent-region callback metadata. A direct disjoint-region regression proves that a qualifying regional update—time-regulating with a TSO-preferred submitted attribute—returns a valid designator even though no subscription overlaps; the ledger supports legal Retract and later terminal classification without retaining typed passels. Default-region synthesis, alternate advance modes, remote transport, save/restore persistence, package evidence, and conformance remain outside this slice.
